description: The surface probe: `pangloss --describe` read by PanGlossSurface.

effects.contract: conservative: a rule is never claimed unable to change a form without proof; unproven is unknown with a reason. notOnForm (reason no_lhs_match) means the rule's target has no match on the allomorph's own form, including across its morpheme edges, and nothing earlier can change the form: no earlier rule in application order is anything but notOnForm on it (else may_be_fed), and no affix modifies stem material. It is not 'cannot change': bleeding is not considered
effects.listedRuleReasons: the loader's own text for a rule that is not compiled or disabled
effects.outputMatchPattern: where the rule's output sits immediately after this rule applies: the environment with the target replaced by what the rule writes (lhs unified with rhs as the engine does), as match text; hand it to match with boundaryMarker when set. Null with an outputUnprintable entry (part outputMatchPattern, typed reason) when it cannot be exact; never approximate. Later rules can change those segments or their environment: outputMayBeAltered is true when the rule is nonLocal a later rule in the same or a later stratum could rewrite a segment the pattern covers, the rule's own output can satisfy its own environment at another site (selfInteraction), or a later stratum has a morphological rule that is not a plain prefix or suffix (laterMorphology); all conservative, with outputMayBeAlteredReasons [{reason, rule}]; null when there is no pattern
effects.ruleText: lhs, environment (left _ right) and rhs are pattern text in the syntax serve match reads, printed exactly or null with an unprintable entry; matchPattern is lhs / environment, to hand match with boundaryMarker when set. A subrule is one rhs alternative; nonLocal is null for a rule that is not compiled

requestFields.attestedWords: array of strings; each surface then carries attested, true when its NFD form is in the list
requestFields.attestedWordsFile: path to a word list, one word per line; as attestedWords. At most one of the two
requestFields.maxTraceSteps: integer >= 1; counts retained trace nodes across every seed
requestFields.maxWork: integer >= 1; lowers the generation cap for this request
requestFields.request: the generate --request v1 object; a root or stem morpheme may carry formGuid to run only the seeds that use that form (an affix may not)
requestFields.trace: boolean, default false; true records each surface's rule steps
requestFields.wordTimeoutMs: integer >= 0; wall-clock deadline for this request

health.contract: result.report is the document `pangloss grammar-health <project>` prints for the same project and options (same code), without the stderr log. Options are --shadowed [--include-selectable] and --stored-analyses bounded|all|off as request fields; includeSelectable requires shadowed. Not offered, because serve has no input for them or they write files: --fst, --fw-project (the project name is taken from the --project path as the command takes it), --snapshot-out, --facts-out, --log-guids. Stored analyses exist only for a .fwdata or .fwbackup project; a snapshot or grammar XML has none, so storedAnalyses changes nothing there. The report is computed from the grammar loaded at startup, never reloaded. Unlike the command, an error-level finding does not make the response an error. The report changes no parse

inventory.classToken: the text between the brackets of [token] in a match pattern: the class name, else its XML id when the name is empty, repeated by an earlier class, or not writable in brackets; null when neither spelling reaches the class
inventory.work: one unit per class and per feature value listed

match.zeroWidth: reported: a pattern that can match the empty string reports an empty match at every position its anchors allow

parse.ruleCosts: true or a positive integer N (true is 8): the response gains a top-level ruleCosts object listing the N objects that reserved the most work steps for this word, with the unattributed remainder; it works on a word the parser stops on. It runs the parse with a stats collector, which does not change workSteps; with traceDetails false and no ruleTrace the parse stays untraced
parse.ruleTrace: with traceDetails false, the JSON rule-trace tree is appended to result only when ruleTrace is true; it is neither built nor sent otherwise. traceDetails true ignores ruleTrace

shadowedAllomorphs.contract: Act only on removableGuids. Never remove another guid from sourceAllomorphGuids. proven verdicts are not yet replayed against C# HC. A row is one HC allomorph: one environment pass of one MSA of a FieldWorks allomorph. shadowed and proven are reported only when every HC copy containing at least one of the row's sourceAllomorphGuids (a circumfix copy contains a prefix and a suffix guid) is shadowed or proven, and removableGuids names the guids for which that holds; a row with none is downgraded to maybe_shadowed or maybe with reason source_allomorph_selectable_elsewhere or source_allomorph_live_elsewhere, and siblings lists the copies that are not. shadowed is proven: no word is parsed or generated with this alternate, because an earlier alternate of the same morpheme is eligible wherever this one is and does not free-fluctuate with it. maybe_shadowed names what was not proven. Proofs use only identical or empty conditions, never a guess; a condition the engine does not model is never counted as covered. The report changes no parse
shadowedAllomorphs.deadContinuationContract: deadContinuations lists root allomorphs after which no affix can attach, because every affix allomorph's required or excluded rule features (inflection class) or required stem name rejects the entry as it stands before its first affix. proven also needs the allomorph unable to stand as a bare word (bound, or every environment needs a neighbouring segment and no phonological rule inserts segments) and no compounding rule; otherwise maybe. Rule-level conditions other than those are ignored, which can only make an affix look attachable. live rows appear with includeSelectable, except a live row with neighbourRejections: an allomorph whose environment needs a following segment, where affixes that could supply it reject the entry's rule features or stem name (blockedBy shape) while others accept; neighbourRejections is an upper bound (any affix that changes rule features, or has an unmodelled shape, counts as a possible supplier; the inserted text is compared with the environment's text, ignoring phonology) and lists only the five most frequent requirements; viaConverter says some affix whose inserted shape has no real segment (a null affix, +∅) accepts the entry and changes its rule features, so the rejecting affixes may be reached after it; the converter's own input pattern and environments are not checked, so it may not apply to this allomorph

deadContinuationReasons.meaning: no affix accepts it, but nothing stops the allomorph standing as a bare word
the grammar has a compounding rule, which can use a root without an affix
the allomorph is bound, so a word needs more than it
every environment of the allomorph requires a segment beside it, which a bare word lacks
another copy of the same FieldWorks allomorph (another MSA of the entry) is not proven dead, so removing the allomorph would lose words
affixes attach, but every environment of the allomorph needs a following segment and each suffix that could start with it rejects the entry's features or stem name; text-based, so only maybe

reasons.meaning: an earlier alternate has no environment and no condition, so it is eligible wherever this one is
every condition of this alternate implies the earlier alternate's conditions
the earlier alternate's environments are not shown to follow from this one's
the input patterns differ and neither is shown to cover the other
the rule-feature requirements differ and the cover is not shown
the required syntactic features differ and the cover is not shown
the stem names share a region, so which words pass each is not decided
another copy of the same FieldWorks allomorph (another environment pass or MSA) is not shadowed, so removing the allomorph would lose words
the earlier alternate has co-occurrence rules, which this version does not model
